subject.title: feat(agents): add iteration budget for agent loop safety

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.defaults/list[].iterationBudget` plus the `onBeforeToolCallingRound` and `supportsIterationBudget` harness contract as the public loop-budget API for this release?
rationale: This is a useful and well-proven safety feature, but repository policy treats new config/default and plugin harness/API surfaces as compatibility-sensitive product direction rather than an automatic bug-fix decision.

options.title: Accept after rebase
options.body: Resolve the current main conflicts, keep the budget disabled by default, and accept the current field names/defaults and fail-closed unsupported-harness behavior.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Ask the author to rename or reduce the config/API surface, or change unsupported-harness behavior, before accepting the feature.

options.title: Defer the core API
options.body: Keep the related issues open and close or pause this PR if maintainers decide existing `runRetries` and loop detection should remain the only core controls for now.

recommendation.title: Accept after rebase
recommendation.body: Resolve the current main conflicts, keep the budget disabled by default, and accept the current field names/defaults and fail-closed unsupported-harness behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: sallyom authored the final maintainer follow-up commits and proof comments on this PR, making them the clearest available owner for the immediate API-shape decision.
